title: Great overview of Cathedral and chapel and the Isabella and Carlos' life in Granada
text: It was great, 3h spent of cathedral and royal chapel. Our guide was very friendly amd knowledgable. We had luck as the time we visited, the floats from semana santa were all on display in the Cathedral, if you can help it, check when that's happening and go then. tickets were included and we skipped the line for the cathedral.

author: Ayelen N

title: An essential to start knowing the city
text:
One of the best free tours I've ever done. The guide, Antonio, was not only a perfect connoisseur of the city, but also enriched the visit with many historical anecdotes from Granada and elsewhere. He showed us some of the most iconic places in the city. 
In other free tours they have been somewhat insistent on the theme of reviews and economic valuation of the tour; Antonio, however, only told us about these aspects after the tour. 
100% recommended
author: hedgiesa

title: This is the best tour guide in Granada
text: I cannot recommend this tour enough. I am blanking on the name of my tour guide because it took me quite some time to get to this but we got this pic with her because she was so extraordinary! She does such an incredible job of telling the story behind the art but adding her own flavor. She is hilarious!!!!!!! This was so enjoyable. I could have spent hours with her. She is so charismatic, knowledgable, and engaging. I can't recommend her enough:-)

title: First of many trips to Granada…
text: Estella was knowledgeable, charming and funny - she was able to speak with confidence while being informative and entertaining at the same time. She arrived promptly; she acknowledged everyone in a friendly manner and opened her orange umbrella so she was visible.
